alpha.description: the engine reads a number > 0, so a fractional alpha is expressible

chunk.description: The training chunk (one batch, one ubatch). An engine before the key takes 512.

exact.description: The exact walk (fork #47): one optimizer step per window on the gradient carried back through every chunk's cached K/V and a hybrid's recurrent state.

fit.description: How an example longer than the window is fitted (fork #29).

max_slowdown_ppm.description: The bound on her decode slowdown while training runs, parts per million (fork #36). Sent instead of the time share (the engine refuses both).

memory_budget_mib.description: what training may add on the GPU: the job's governed lease, which the engine enforces before allocating

out.description: a bare `<job>.gguf` name; the engine writes it inside the lane's `--train-dir`

recompute.description: Per-layer recompute (fork #37): a chunk holds one layer's activations, not every layer's.

top_layers.description: adapt only the last K blocks (fork #27); omitted = every block

walk_host_budget_mib.description: The exact walk's host memory per window.

EngineExample.description: One `/train` example: a prompt/completion pair, or a served conversation (OpenAI message shape exactly as serving framed it, with the tools she was offered).

Fit.description: How an example longer than the window is fitted (fork #29).

oneOf.description: keep the system and tool head and her reply; drop the OLDEST history exchanges
